IND.agenda: Addresses the current reported referendums in occupied Ukrainian regions; does not describe them as a future September 22 plan.
IND.charter: Preserves sovereignty and territorial integrity under international law/the UN Charter.
IND.draft_status: Identifies the US-announced forthcoming draft as a proposal; explicitly says the supplied dossier establishes neither this requested delegation's endorsement nor a recorded vote. Absence is not proof of no real official position.
IND.hostilities: Calls for immediate cessation of hostilities.
IND.dialogue: Calls for dialogue/diplomacy/return to negotiating table.
IND.aid: Preserves India's humanitarian assistance to Ukraine as an existing action.
IND.neighbours: Separately preserves India's economic support to neighbours under economic stress, without changing it into aid to Russia or making neighbours synonymous with Ukraine.
IND.global_south: Retains food, fuel and fertilizer costs/shortages affecting the global South.
IND.accountability: Retains objective/independent investigation of violations, without claiming India joined the ICC or changing investigation into a completed conviction.

GBR.agenda: Addresses the current reported referendums in occupied Ukrainian regions; does not describe them as a future September 22 plan.
GBR.charter: Preserves sovereignty and territorial integrity under international law/the UN Charter.
GBR.draft_status: Identifies the US-announced forthcoming draft as a proposal; explicitly says the supplied dossier establishes neither this requested delegation's endorsement nor a recorded vote. Absence is not proof of no real official position.
GBR.responsibility: Preserves UK attribution of an illegal invasion/aggression to Russia; does not replace it with undifferentiated blame.
GBR.referendums: Rejects the referendums as a rigged/sham exercise.
GBR.nonrecognition: Refuses recognition of annexation or the referendum results; not a reported later vote.
GBR.withdrawal: Calls on Russia/Putin to withdraw from Ukraine.
GBR.support: Preserves continuing UK support for Ukraine.

guards.one_role: One requested delegation only; no other speaker, no change of country/capacity.
guards.grounding: No unsupported historical events, named organizations, numerical commitments, operations, official policy or purported quotes.
guards.attribution: Does not appropriate the other country's distinctive aid, economic, referendum, or other stated commitment as an observed position of the requested country. Shared Charter/accountability principles can be shared.
guards.time_authority: No future vote/outcome/own-draft endorsement invented; prior remarks remain prior, no claim this construction is an authentic September 27 quotation.
guards.public_output: Nonempty public statement with no visible reasoning loop or output cap.

rating: met/unmet/uncertain with full-output quotes. Any unmet or uncertain unit/guard prevents strict pass. Omission differs from incompatible or unsupported addition.
reviewer: same assistant as curator; independent review pending
claim_boundary: Observable evidence-conditioned application with same dossier and requested-role switch, not neutral truth, national preference discovery, sealed OOD, decision prediction or collective benefit.
